correctness.rationale: Exact monomial normalized matrix reconstructed. Uniform gamma-ratio estimates, summable row-error O(n^{-2-epsilon}), beta integral, bounded k>N cutoff loss, and uniform exponential-tilt logarithmic Riemann sums yield O(1) critical-window norm and the bivariate weak limit. Explicit ratio tail exponents alpha+2>0 and alpha<0 establish tightness. Infinite epsilon asymptotic uses zeta(1+epsilon)=epsilon^{-1}+O(1). Finite checker verified small cases but is not used to claim an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The differential Hilbert operator’s sharp full-operator boundedness threshold motivates determining the entrywise Hilbert–Schmidt energy distribution of finite polynomial sections on both sides of that boundary. The bivariate beta-prime/logarithmic law resolves where matrix mass accumulates, and the signed 1/log N window resolves how it changes under a natural near-critical deformation. This is a structural local limit and sharp finite-cutoff law, not an arbitrary degree slice or a mere restatement of Schatten membership; no singular-value distribution is asserted.
